fact_text: Growth in property, plant and equipment (PPE) additions in reported accounts is a leading signal: capex spent in a year lifts sales in later years, then profit and dividends.

fact_text: Letter of credit restrictions eased somewhat in late 2023 and API imports may have resumed, after a sharp rise in the dollar had hurt pharma companies.
